blocks.text: THE LONG FOUGHT BATTLE OF THE PROPHETS ABOUT TO END— And for the elect it will end at Capstone giving forth new light to the nations for translative faith! (Yea this be the Temple of the most high) THE ROCK of ages is behind it, the face of the living God! Jesus sets “His wheels of fire” in motion and His saints are exalted out of the dust, and the elect are translated into a heavenly position as kings and priests of the Royal Prince (Christ). Behold the earth cometh to the end of a long travail and the sun woman (Rev. 12) brings forth the precious fruit! Yea the harvest is ripe and ready, the call of the reaper is here! Be patient therefore brethren unto the coming of the Lord! Behold the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receives the early and latter rain. — (Mal. 3:17) and they shall be mine saith the Lord of Host, in that day when I make up my jewels, and I will spare them, as a man spareth His own son that serveth him! — “Behold I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the Lord. (Mal. 4:5) Lest I come smite the earth with a curse-and his voice shall be stout! “This also speaks of the spirit which was upon Elijah will drop upon a powerful messenger! — I Jesus have sent Mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the Bright and Morning Star! The spirit and the bride say come and let him take the water of life freely! (Rev. 22:16-17) — And many that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt, but the wise shall shine like the brightness of the firmament! (Dan. 12:2-3) -Behold the judge standeth at the door — the King of saints is near!”

THE HIDDEN MYSTERY THE ANCIENT ROCK OF AGES EXALTED— Something unique and wonderful is appearing and is proven in this book already with Scriptural confirmation. Oh mighty is our God! “The prophets including David spoke of it, the Lord waited thousands of years to reveal it, He has given a witness and sign to the very elect! “Israel received great signs coming out of Egypt, but Jesus will reveal to us even mightier signs, and satan will not be able to imitate this “last sign and 7th. wonder seal, for there is fire with thunder in it!” I have seen the face of the Lord in the morning, and in the twilight I have seen His form and countenance!” Oh He is real! Believe with all your heart ye people! I stood right there and looked right at Him and He ts ready to do unusual miracles. — “David said thou art my rock and fortress”. In Ps. 61:2 he said lead me to that rock that is higher than I — “He also said, set my King upon a hill’. — Also I am literally writing under the shadow of a GREAT ROCK! The Lord has given the great ancient mountain sign to jolt the elect into preparation for His return, giving faith for translation. If a person rejects the picture of the Lord Jesus on top then he will receive judgment from the one whose head is in the corner! The great rocks line up with the very corner of Capstone. There are several parts to the mountainous rock, but form only one face and head! (one God, the Headstone!) And behind Him the seats in Capstone forms a rainbow over His head lining up with the mountain! (see pictures side ways in new book.) Yea delight thyself O elect for this is the Lord’s work and is marvelous in our eyes! Yea this is the appearing of the “White Eagle” the very God, (Omega) prophet in Rock!

THE VOICE AND THE SOUND— THE 7TH. ANGEL IN THE PYRAMID (White Rock) — We are coming to a new dispensation and dimension. God’s voice directly through a messenger will report time is no more! And at his cry, 7 Thunders uttered. The mystery of God is finishing up! Thus saith the Lord! In (Rev. 10:4) the Thunders uttered their message. Then in verse 6 the angel declares no more time! Part of the secret of the Thunders is the very time element. Verse 7, and in the days of the voice (sign) of the 7th. angel (God in a prophet) crowned with 7 anointings! Rev. 4:5) This would be his job to reveal the very nearness of the translation! Not the exact day but the nearness of the translation, and the answer (mysteries) would be written on rolls (little seals) — And when he shall begin to “sound” (stir) reveal, call the elect who will hear the “sound.” It was a particular “sound” a noted thing. The bride (elect) will hear and receive it! Notice it said in the “days” (verse 7) so when He begins “calling” actually there are just a few (days) years left! Remember there was “‘the voice” and “the sound” — the voice is the sign in Him the 7th. wonder to the elect! “The voice” will have a strange and mysterious “sound” to the world, but the saints will love the “sound” of the voice (sign) — when we hear the voice from a lion we know from the “sound” it is a lion, and when we hear the cry from an eagle we know from “the sound” that it is an eagle! And when we hear “the voice” in this messenger we will know by “the sound” that it is a heavenly message in him! The “voice” and the “sound of the 7th. angel (Christ) uniting His own! Behold I do sound and thunder! Read I Kings 19:13 “Behold read” (Rev. 1:12, 15) “The voice and sound”! (The times of the Gentiles are ending in this last messenger.)

“WHEN THOU HEAREST THE SOUND”— THE SPIRIT IN THE “TOPS” OF THE MULBERRY TREES — (II Sam. 5:24) it means God has taken the battle for the elect! “Yea the Captain of the Host is among His people!” The “Voice of the spirit is moving before His tree (elect!), the revival of complete deliverance is appearing today, the saints will win the battle for translation!” I can hear “the sound” coming in the tree (elect) at “the top” (Capstone!) — “God’s wheels spinning before us” The Lord is going to work in a magnetic and electrifying manner soon! (After the stirring in the Mulberry trees the Ark appeared on a “new cart” going homeward! (II Sam. 6:3) — Remember the “sound” in Elijah’s rain? (I Kings 18:41) New spiritual things near!

THE MOST INSPIRING events are approaching — Jesus will appear very outwardly in true reality more than ever! — “So powerful that it will actually frighten the lukewarm and foolish! “Remember when He thundered on Mt. Sinai the people decided they didn’t want to be that close to Him! Amen!” We are living in an hour when the Lord’s rod will be among His people also! (Rev. 2:27-Rev. 12:5) — “The Temple here is just full of the power of God, a thick presence is in it! There is only one life to live, and everyone should see Capstone before His return. We want all to come and be healed, no disease can stand here. When a person lines up with the Headstone, diseases and devils fall like the lightning!

YEA SAITH THE LORD remember My servant David when he wrote, and said, (II Sam. 22:7-14) “and he did hear My voice out of his Temple, then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved and shook because he was wroth, there went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it. He bowed the heavens also and came down; And He rode upon a cherub, and did fly; and he was seen upon the wings of the wind! Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled. The Lord “thundered” from heaven, and the most High uttered His “voice!” — “Yea the Lord is about to do an extreme intense work like stones of fire, and thou doest well to believe!” — “In this hour I Jesus rejoice in spirit, for blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see: for I tell you that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which ye shall see, and have not seen them, and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.” — Blessed be the name of our Lord Jesus, King forever and forever!
The scrolls written by authority-appointed to be read in the church elect! — “He that hath an ear, let him hear what the spirit saith unto the churches!” Amen!
